data.one_liner: Create ordered tours to introduce widget features in your app using enums.
data.what_it_does: Enables you to build ordered, step-by-step feature tours and user onboarding flows. It highlights specific widgets, supports custom callouts and buttons, persists progress via a controller, and provides lifecycle callbacks.
use_when: You need to guide first-time users through your app interface.
You want ordered widget highlights driven by strongly typed enums.
avoid_when: You need complex out-of-the-box multi-page dialog walkthroughs without widget wrappers.
Your app does not use Flutter or Material.
strengths: Strongly typed enum-based step ordering and caching.
Extensive customization options for callouts, buttons, and global defaults.
weaknesses: Requires wrapping individual target widgets with `FeaturesTour`.
Persisted state changes keys on upgrade, causing tours to show once more.
data.setup_notes: Initialize global config or set up a FeaturesTourController with an enum.
data.minimal_example:
final tourController = FeaturesTourController<HomeTourStep>('HomePage');

FeaturesTour<HomeTourStep>(
    controller: tourController,
    step: HomeTourStep.drawer,
    nextStep: HomeTourStep.drawerButton,
    introduce: const Text('Tap here to open the drawer'),
    child: IconButton(
        icon: const Icon(Icons.menu),
        onPressed: () {},
    ),
)
